commands: echo "GHA=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset}"; echo "branch=$(git branch --show-current)"; git status --short | head; jq -r '.version' .claude-plugin/plugin.json
git branch --show-current; git status --short; jq -r '.version' .claude-plugin/plugin.json; printf 'GHA=%s\n' "$GITHUB_ACTIONS"

cp scripts/render-prompt-extension.sh .prflow/tmp/rpe-backup.sh
printf '\n# mutation-probe\n' >> scripts/render-prompt-extension.sh
echo "=== verify after mutation ==="; python3 lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py verify; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- restore ---"
cp .prflow/tmp/rpe-backup.sh scripts/render-prompt-extension.sh
rm .prflow/tmp/rpe-backup.sh
echo "=== verify after restore ==="; python3 lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py verify; echo "rc=$?"
git diff --stat scripts/render-prompt-extension.sh

python3 - <<'PY'
import sys, importlib
sys.path.insert(0, "lib/test"); sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import cloud_writer_contract as cwc
vcwc = importlib.import_module("validate-cloud-writer-contract")

VP = cwc.VENDOR_PREFIX
def _cwv(n): return VP + "scripts/" + n

# Mirror _FROZEN_LEGACY_GRANTS from the edited test file
frozen = {
  "implement": {_cwv(x) for x in ["run-jq.sh","config-get.sh","workpad.py","parse-acs.py","branch-for-issue.py","update-branch-che …[per-command-truncated]

git add lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py lib/test/cloud_writer_deps.py lib/test/test_python_scripts.py scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json
git status --short
git commit -q -m "$(printf 'feat(#1359): advance LEGACY_PROFILE_BASELINE and register render-prompt-extension.sh in the cloud-writer closure

Advance LEGACY_PROFILE_BASELINE from 2.30.100 to 2.31.16 (the plugin version
that first shipped render-prompt-extension.sh in 2.31.13), and register the
wrapper as a required helper head o …[per-command-truncated]

scripts/workpad.py update 1359 --pr-link "https://github.com/The01Geek/prflow/pull/1363" --tick-progress "code + sweeps" 2>&1 | head -1
ls .changeset/*.md | head -3; echo "=== sample ==="; head -20 $(ls .changeset/*.md | grep -v README | head -1)

timeout 60 python3 -c "
import lib.test.cloud_writer_contract as c
import lib.test.cloud_writer_deps as d
print('contract import ok')
print('deps import ok')
# any self-check functions
print([f for f in dir(c) if f.startswith('check')])
print([f for f in dir(d) if f.startswith('check')])
print('shape conf:', c.check_shape_conformance())
" 2>&1 | tail -20

for c in $(git log --reverse --format=%H --since="2026-08-01" -- .claude-plugin/plugin.json | head -40); do if git cat-file -e $c:scripts/render-prompt-extension.sh 2>/dev/null; then echo "first version-bump commit containing wrapper: $c"; git show $c:.claude-plugin/plugin.json | grep -m1 version; break; fi; done

git log --reverse --format=%H -- .claude-plugin/plugin.json > /tmp/vc.txt; while read -r c; do if git cat-file -e "$c:scripts/render-prompt-extension.sh" 2>/dev/null; then echo "first plugin.json commit with wrapper: $c"; git show "$c:.claude-plugin/plugin.json" | grep -m1 version; break; fi; done < /tmp/vc.txt

V_PLUGIN=$(jq -r .version .claude-plugin/plugin.json)
V_MANIFEST=$(jq -r .legacy_profile_baseline scripts/devflow-cloud-writer-contract.json)
V_CONST=$(python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'lib/test'); import cloud_writer_contract as c; print(c.LEGACY_PROFILE_BASELINE)")
printf 'plugin=%s manifest=%s const=%s\n' "$V_PLUGIN" "$V_MANIFEST" "$V_CONST"
echo "--- forbidden-edit check (plugin.json / CHANGELOG.md must be untouched) ---"
git diff main...HEAD --name-only | grep -E "plugin.json|CHANG …[per-command-truncated]
echo "=== reception-record ==="; scripts/reception-record.py --help 2>&1 | head -25; echo "=== checkout-fingerprint ==="; scripts/checkout-fingerprint.py --help 2>&1 | head -20

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1359/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
printf 'trigger=%s\n' "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"
if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then
  scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray --report-failure …[per-command-truncated]
